description: This Python source file defines the GcsPubSubLogger class, a specialized logger for Google Cloud Pub/Sub integration within the LiteLLM project. It handles batching, message encoding, and asynchronous publishing to GCS Pub/Sub, utilizing various project-specific utilities and external libraries.

classes.name: GcsPubSubLogger
classes.description: A logger class for Google Cloud Pub/Sub integration, supporting batching, message encoding, header construction, and asynchronous publication to GCS Pub/Sub topics, designed specifically for the LiteLLM project.
